content.text: {"answer":"No. Otto's spec says a tool must not declare a customer id, company id or account number in its input schema. The customer number comes from the authenticated organisation's `customerNumber`, which a scope resolver (`clerkOrgResolver`, returning a `TmsCallScope` that carries only `customerNumber`) reads. Issue 560 adds schema validation at tool registration to reject such definitions, so tools can't bypass the resolver. I read only excerpts, not the full spec, so I haven't seen the exact wording of the rule or confirmed that the validation is implemented.","sources":["issue-560","issue-18","specs/support-agent-tms-access/spec.md (FR-031, FR-034 and the requirement at line 96)"]}
